items.headline: MWC matchup features UNLV taking on Wyoming
items.description: Wyoming (5-3) at UNLV (5-3), Nov. 7 at 10:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes throws 2 TD passes, runs for score in Wyoming's 28-14 victory over Air Force
items.description: — Tyler Hughes finished with two touchdown passes and a touchdown run to propel Wyoming to a 28-14 victory over the Air Force Academy on Friday night.

items.headline: Miami's 2001 throwbacks lead best Week 8 uniforms in college football
items.description: The Hurricanes are the No. 1 team in the country for the first time in over two decades, and they're honoring the early-2000s glory days with their Week 8 threads.

items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Air Force takes on Wyoming in MWC action
items.description: Air Force (5-1) at Wyoming (4-3), Oct. 23 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes totals 379 yards on offense and Wyoming dumps Northern Illinois 41-23
items.description: — Tyler Hughes compiled 379 yards of total offense and scored four rushing touchdowns to lead Wyoming's 41-23 victory over Northern Illinois on Saturday.
